teaching.description: Peter sought to comfort believers who were suffering a "fiery trial," the persecution under the emperor Nero. Persecution is not some strange thing that happens to the Christian, but if we suffer with Him we will reign with Him.
teaching.name: 1 Peter 4:12-19

content: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

content: To the elders among you, I appeal as a fellow elder and a witness of Christ’s sufferings who also will share in the glory to be revealed:
